scope: Partial source-assisted labels, not exhaustive independently corrected truth.
Synthetic examples are constructed training data, not corrected annotations of the original artwork.
Known-label metrics exclude unknown pixels; this is not a complete precision audit.
Validation informed iterative experiments; it is not an independent final test.
No reserved test layouts were evaluated.
None of these candidates has a newly trained production light-center head.
Trials v6-v8 failed pixel-level checks; their exported geometry and recolors were not evaluated.
Trials v9-v11 were additionally evaluated through the actual runtime at per-class profile thresholds on all five validation maps, original and recolored.

Trial v12 selected checkpoints on the same five validation maps; its post-selection runtime evaluation also includes newly reserved Cinderglass, for six maps total. It did not train on either new landscape.

Trial v13 adds Sunspoke training negatives and selects checkpoints on six validation layouts including Cinderglass. Its aggregate selection score is not comparable to prior five-layout selection scores; inspect the shared-layout metrics and actual exports.

Trials v14-v15 keep the same six validation layouts and four reserved final-test layouts. Gullthorn additions affect only its existing training sample. Training-layout fit is a diagnostic, not independent validation.

The explicit structure-free export assertion evaluates whole maps independently of partial pixel labels. Cached Cinderglass re-extraction matches the original structural counts; lights are outside this assertion.
Geometry timing during other work is not used as a speed comparison.

trials.reason: Frozen legacy tensors did not preserve winning probabilities: held-out glass recall was zero and door recall deteriorated.

configuration.loss: weighted cross entropy plus window Dice
configuration.optimizer: AdamW, window output row only, weight_decay=0

legacy_tensor_identity.note: Softmax probabilities can still change when the new window logit competes.

trials.reason: Learns glass on its training layout but has zero held-out glass recall. Fence recall and older-map wall precision fail. Experimental architecture is not production-runtime compatible.

configuration.loss: weighted cross entropy plus foreground Dice plus 0.001*mean squared residual
configuration.optimizer: AdamW, residual decoder and DINO context projection only

legacy_tensor_identity.note: Segmentation logits change through the added residual.

trials.reason: More varied procedural frames did not solve real-glass generalization: held-out glass recall remains zero. Fence recall and older-map precision fail. Experimental architecture is not production-runtime compatible.

configuration.loss: weighted cross entropy plus foreground Dice plus 0.001*mean squared residual
configuration.optimizer: AdamW, residual decoder and DINO context projection only

legacy_tensor_identity.note: Segmentation logits change through the added residual.

trials.reason: Reference consistency recovers some older-map wall recall but fails actual exports: no Mothveil door or window, no Rimebell fence, and older-map door regressions. Tiny false wall pixels on Antler are removed by geometry filtering; it exports no structures there.

teacher.scope: Training groups only. Known labels must agree with teacher argmax; unknown pixels require teacher confidence >=0.9. KL includes all student classes; the legacy teacher assigns zero window mass.

geometry_annotations.ray_assumption: Sight rays use opaque walls and assume doors are closed. Movement rays also use exported windows and movement-only barriers. Review-only transparent-barrier candidates are excluded because they are not exported. Window sight blocking follows Foundry proximity-window semantics only approximately; per-world proximity distance is not modeled.

incomplete_environment_full_suite_attemp.reason: The portable ML runtime lacks requests, which the legacy image-utils tests import. Full-suite rerun uses the complete development environment.

initial_replay_fixture_failure.cause: The new synthetic fixture requested a 48-pixel detector resolution, below the existing supported minimum of 256. The fixture was enlarged to a supported resolution; production validation was not relaxed.

ruff.command: python -B -m ruff check benchmarks/evaluate_structures.py tests/test_structure_metrics.py tests/test_encounter_training.py

previous_packaging_ci_failure.cause: Git line-ending conversion changed stored annotation bytes, invalidating review hashes outside the working checkout. Fixed with scoped JSON -text attributes and renormalization; exact staged bytes were then checked against the review hashes.

remote_ci.scope: Targeted Linux CPU structure-model workflow; local full CUDA suite recorded separately.

visual_review.scope: All 16 composed images inspected at native contact-sheet resolution. Insertions lie within verified built-wall caps, with horizontal and vertical orientations and four frame/pane variants. Yellow outlines and text occur only in the preview, not training pixels. These are artificial windows, not claims that the original sources contain windows. Existing partial labels outside insertions and jambs are retained, not exhaustively re-reviewed.
visual_review.limitations: Simple generated materials and four repeated placements; cannot establish performance on unmodified real glass or other art styles.

frostwake_rails.scope: Only four new rail/post interiors were reviewed here. Prior partial regions are inherited unchanged, not certified as exhaustive corrected truth.

frostwake-beacon.notes: Four narrow visible wood interiors on the existing courtyard railing. Exactly 613 unknown pixels become class 4; no prior supervised pixels change. No prediction labels. Training layout only.

additional_training_data.sampling_caveat: Raising Frostwake weight changes its frequency for all represented target classes, not fences alone. Fence-target share changes from 1/13 to 10/22 after including procedural examples.

new_landscapes.scope: Independent primary source/overlay review of two new landscape maps. Selected negatives only; possible emitters remain unknown. No prediction labels, no old split changes, no final-test evaluation.

cinderglass-basin.reviewer: primary native-source and third-draft raster review
cinderglass-basin.notes: No visible architectural structures anywhere on this landscape. Pixel labels deliberately exclude uncertain emitters; exported structure counts must remain zero even outside the selected negative regions.

sunspoke-shoals.reviewer: primary native-source and third-draft raster review
sunspoke-shoals.notes: No visible architectural structures anywhere on this landscape. Pixel labels deliberately exclude uncertain emitters; exported structure counts must remain zero even outside the selected negative regions.

structure_free_check_revision.scope: Add explicit structure_free=true to enforce the already reviewed zero-export expectation. Source, raster supervision, split and reviewed raster previews unchanged. This assertion covers the whole map without relabelling uncertain emitters as background.

additional_training_data.new_landscape_scope: Two new layouts: Sunspoke train, Cinderglass validation, fixed before any prediction evaluation. All 86 prior sample images, masks and splits retained. Two earlier Cinderglass drafts rejected before admission/training. Accepted cold-region negatives keep possible emitters unknown. No trials through v12 train on these two maps.

gullthorn_rails.scope: Primary reviewed eleven narrow visible wood interiors and two explicit non-structure patches on a different real guardrail layout. Prior partial annotations inherited unchanged, not certified as complete truth. No predictions used for labels.

gullthorn-blind.notes: Eleven rail/post interiors: visible wood only. Excludes tree, ladder and lantern. Two negative patches are clear platform floor and a crate, not structures. All 2506 changed pixels were previously unknown. Passage checks cross the full selected front-left guardrail; perfect partial labels pass sight-open/movement-blocked extraction. Training layout only; final tests unchanged.

additional_training_data.gullthorn_rail_scope: Eleven visible wood interiors and two clear floor/crate patches add 1622 fence and 884 background pixels, all previously unknown. Every prior supervised pixel retained. Only the Gullthorn training sample changes; sampling weight 1 -> 10 affects its background and fence targets. Fence-target shares are Frostwake 10/32, Gullthorn 10/32, legacy wood camp 10/32, procedural examples 2/32.

gullthorn_boundary_negatives.scope: Primary source-reviewed platform floor and crate interiors. Failure analysis motivated the areas to inspect; source artwork determined every label. All earlier partial supervision and splits preserved. No claim of independent human correction or complete topology.

gullthorn-blind.reviewer: primary native-coordinate source and 5x raster-overlay review
gullthorn-blind.notes: Three negative polygons change only unknown pixels to background. Existing 1622 guardrail-positive pixels remain unchanged. Tree, ladder, lantern and unreviewed boundaries stay outside the new polygons. Training layout only; validation and final-test annotations unchanged.

additional_training_data.gullthorn_boundary_scope: Observed v14 spill motivated native-source review of floor and crate interiors. Three new polygons change only 2697 unknown pixels to background; all earlier labels remain unchanged. Source pixels determine the labels, not predictions. Same sampling weights, initializer, optimizer, seed, crops, validation and final tests as v14.

new_landscape_whole_map_export_checks.scope: Re-extraction of archived label/confidence predictions. Structural counts match the prior runtime reports. No new ML inference, training or label changes. Lights excluded.

same_class_connected_growth.result: v9 Mothveil strong-seed connected growth from class-2 pixels at >=0.5 increased mask area from 782 to 1056 but still produced zero supported doors. Not integrated.

image_guided_color_growth.result: Recovers the annotated original Mothveil door on v9-v11, but not its recolor. Legacy Rimebell gains two matched original doors; the recolored Stone north gate is a real visible gate but fails the existing endpoint tolerance after expansion. Existing accepted spans can also move. No promotion or integration; thresholds/annotations were not relaxed.

image_guided_growth_v2.scope: Unshipped bounded image-guided growth from existing strong ML seeds. No labels, model thresholds or geometry checks changed.
image_guided_growth_v2.harness_correction: Initial diagnostic run called public UVTT conversion for Foundry movement-only barriers and stopped. Use internal preview conversion for legacy span metrics; native structure checks assess movement separately. Initial failed log retained; this was an evaluation-harness error, not a demonstrated method limitation.
image_guided_growth_v2.result: Recovers Mothveil door in both appearances for all three evaluated models, but v13 invents a door on a plain gray wall indentation. Real Stone gate endpoints overrun solid jambs. Not integrated.

image_guided_growth_v3.scope: Unshipped bounded image-guided growth from strong ML seeds, requiring local material contrast against confident walls. Re-run existing weak-jamb recovery after growth so new complete portals can recover their real inner jambs. No labels, model thresholds or shape/jamb checks relaxed.
image_guided_growth_v3.harness_correction: Initial diagnostic run called public UVTT conversion for Foundry movement-only barriers and stopped. Use internal preview conversion for legacy span metrics; native structure checks assess movement separately. Initial failed log retained; this was an evaluation-harness error, not a demonstrated method limitation.
image_guided_growth_v3.result: Local wall-median contrast does not reject the false gray-indentation door. Re-running existing weak-jamb recovery fixes one gate attachment but other endpoint failures remain. Not integrated.

image_guided_growth_v4.scope: Unshipped bounded image-guided growth from strong ML seeds, rejecting growth when at least ten percent of nearby confident wall pixels match the seed material within its existing color tolerance. Re-run existing weak-jamb recovery after growth so new complete portals can recover their real inner jambs. No labels, model thresholds or shape/jamb checks relaxed.
image_guided_growth_v4.harness_correction: Initial diagnostic run called public UVTT conversion for Foundry movement-only barriers and stopped. Use internal preview conversion for legacy span metrics; native structure checks assess movement separately. Initial failed log retained; this was an evaluation-harness error, not a demonstrated method limitation.
image_guided_growth_v4.result: Rejecting growth that matches a substantial local wall-color subset removes the fake indentation on v13, but v9 recolored still invents it and Stone gate endpoint failures remain. Mothveil door matches in both appearances on all three models. Not integrated.

benchmark_cache.change: Future evaluations preserve exact working-resolution class IDs and winning confidence separately from source-size display rasters. Exact source-coordinate DetectionResult geometry is also saved. Paths, sizes and file hashes are recorded in each sample result.
benchmark_cache.scope: Earlier source-size preview caches on downscaled maps are not exact working predictions and must not be resized back for purported exact replay. This does not change original inference or geometry metrics. Prior cached six-validation-map probes asserted no map downscaling. Prediction caches omit light-center heatmaps; saved detection geometry retains emitted light records.
benchmark_cache.storage: BMP, NPY and JSON; no archive or filesystem compression.

training_layout_boundary_fit.scope: Training-layout diagnostic on identical v2 partial labels, not held-out accuracy. Exact working-size predictions reproduce source-coordinate geometry and passage checks. Pixel precision excludes unknown areas. No light heatmap replay claimed.

unchanged_fence_filter_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic of unchanged production shape filtering at existing class confidence. Component rejection is not evidence that every rejected pixel is a fence; no unfiltered geometry is promoted or exported.
